SiteNav.slogan: Reserve your table at a restaurant you love, confirmed in minutes.

Hero.baslikVarsayilan: Your <v>seat</v> is ready at the best tables in town.
Hero.baslikSehirli: Your <v>seat</v> is ready at the best tables in {sehirEki}.
Hero.aciklama: Pick your city, date and time, and send your reservation request to the restaurant in seconds. Get the answer by email.

Anasayfa.metaBaslik: Find Your Table, Send a Free Reservation Request
Anasayfa.metaAciklama: Discover restaurants in your city, pick a date and time, and send your reservation request in seconds. No sign-up required, always free.
Anasayfa.restoranaDogrudanAciklama: No middleman, your request goes directly to the restaurant
Anasayfa.epostaAciklama: Approval or decline lands in your inbox as soon as the restaurant replies
Anasayfa.dogrulanmisAciklama: Only guests who actually visited can leave a review
Anasayfa.semtBaslik: Every neighborhood has its own flavor
Anasayfa.yorumSistemiBaslik: Only those who sat at the table have a say.
Anasayfa.yorumMadde1: No review can be written until the restaurant confirms the reservation
Anasayfa.yorumMadde2: The review invite opens only after the visit takes place
Anasayfa.yorumMadde3: Every review is tied to a real reservation record
Anasayfa.henuzYorumYok: No experiences shared yet. Be the first to leave a review.
Anasayfa.nasilCalisirBaslik: Reach a restaurant in three steps
Anasayfa.nasilCalisirAciklama: No complicated sign-ups or payment steps. Send your request and wait for the restaurant's reply.
Anasayfa.adim1Aciklama: Choose the location, date, time and party size, and find your restaurant.
Anasayfa.adim2Aciklama: Your reservation request reaches the restaurant instantly.
Anasayfa.adim3Aciklama: You'll be notified as soon as the restaurant confirms or declines.
Anasayfa.kapanisBaslik: A great evening starts with the right table.
